main.title: Summary
text: SRE with 8 years of experience running large Kubernetes platforms on GCP and AWS. I focus on reliability, cost and developer experience. Experienced in incident management, SLO design and building internal platforms.

items.heading: Lead SRE — Example Streaming
bullets: Run 14 GKE clusters serving 2M daily users; availability 99.95% over the last year.
Designed SLOs and error budgets with product teams; on-call load reduced by 40%.
Built a GitOps platform with Argo CD and Helm used by 25 teams.
Cut cloud costs by 28% through autoscaling and spot instances.

items.heading: DevOps Engineer — Sample Telecom
bullets: Automated provisioning with Terraform and Ansible.
